description: Two small rectangular enclosures of Late Iron Age date, interpreted as 'ceremonial', and so the RSRB has tagged the site as a 'shrine'. Nearby is a Roman iron smelting furnace from mid 2nd - mid 3rd CE.
bibliography: Ashwin, T, and S Bates. “Southern Norwich By-Pass, Part 1: Excavations at Bixley, Casitor St Edmunds.” East Anglian Archaeology 91 (2000).
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Valley Belt, Trowse (Norfolk).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
